title: OPEN (runner → adapter)
description: First message of every adapter session (SPEC.md §5). Derived from internal/protocol.Message: every field but `type` carries `omitempty`, so an OPEN with an empty config omits the key entirely.

step_id.description: The pipeline step id this session serves.

config.description: The step's resolved `with:` block, validated against the manifest's config_schema before it is sent.
